title: Dose-response meta-analysis in the browser: a tool validated against the R package dosresmeta
description: The allmeta dose-response meta-analysis app (validated at allmeta commit 0f8b86d) and a one-command validation against the R package dosresmeta on every multi-study binary dataset bundled with dosresmeta. The app fits linear, quadratic and restricted cubic spline curves with Greenland-Longnecker, Hamling or independent within-study covariance, by two-stage (REML, ML, method of moments, fixed effect; optional meta-regression) or one-stage approaches, and reports heterogeneity, Wald and goodness-of-fit tests and predictions. Across 724 model, covariance, approach and method combinations on 16 datasets (187 studies), the app agrees with dosresmeta on all 724: 576 fits within numerical tolerance and the same 148 refusals. Includes the corpus builder, R reference fits, the engine runner, the analysis that regenerates the article's tables, figures and statistics with a PASS/FAIL check of every number, a Docker image (canonical environment: R 4.6.0, dosresmeta 2.2.0, Node 24.15.0) and CI on Linux, Windows, macOS and Docker. Earlier app versions had known issues, fixed in allmeta PR #76 (see CHANGELOG.md).
